answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy requires a 1000 POA bond locked for 30 days. A newcomer completes three varied tasks, and five independent established peers attest each execution. Fraud or duplicate identities forfeit the bond and trigger a seven-day cooldown; reputation rises only after two consecutive passing rounds. Thus 100 fake agents cost 100 bonds, 300 task attempts, and 500 attestations, while signed logs and replay checks verify the work. The terms thread sparrow forge appear naturally in this mechanism.
